faq.q: What are these AI product photo and video examples?
faq.a: They are finished looks you can redo with your own item. The six cards on this page are photos. A product photo to video ad, with an actor, a spoken line, and captions, starts from the same kind of photo.

faq.q: How do I recreate an example with my own product?
faq.a: Upload a photo of your item and open the example you liked. Your file is built from that photo, in the same kind of scene. You can then add a script, an actor, and captions if you want a short ad.

faq.q: Why start from an example instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: An example shows a finished direction before you book a shoot or a creator. Upload one product photo, make a still or a short ad, and check the product before you publish it.
Stores, marketers, agencies, and anyone selling online who wants a product photo or a short ad without a studio day.

faq.q: Can a beginner use an example?
faq.a: Yes. You do not need editing experience. Upload a product photo, open a look, and the tool can add the script, the actor, and the captions.

faq.q: Which products do these examples fit?
faq.a: The page shows a mug, a tote, a vase, a wallet, a shoe, and sunscreen. The same path fits skincare, beauty, fashion, food and drink, technology, fitness, and home goods.

faq.q: Can I upload my own product photo?
faq.a: Yes. The product in your file comes from the photo you upload, or from a product page link. Use a photo that shows the whole item. See [URL to video](page:url-to-video).

faq.q: Which platforms can I publish to?
faq.a: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. Frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. You can send the file from the tool or download it and post it yourself.

faq.q: Is there a free plan for these examples?
faq.a: No. The pictures on this page are demonstrations, not files to repost. A file you generate uses credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month with 200 credits, and the download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I use a file I make in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. A file you generate can be used commercially and has no watermark. You can run it as an ad or post it on your store.

faq.q: Why use an example instead of starting from nothing?
faq.a: An example already has a scene, a crop, and a mood. You spend your time on the product and the line, not on building the shot from a blank page.
